source_caption:
The legendary scene born from a fart.

This lineup sequence from The Usual Suspects (1995) was supposed to be a serious, tense moment to establish these hardened criminals. But the actors Benicio del Toro, Kevin Spacey, Gabriel Byrne, Kevin Pollak, and Stephen Baldwin simply couldn't stop breaking character and laughing through take after take. Director Bryan Singer tried everything to regain control, even furiously scolding them during lunch, but nothing worked. It turns out, Benicio del Toro farting mid-take didn't exactly help matters. Eventually, a frustrated Singer gave up trying to make it serious and just used the take where they couldn't stop giggling.

What was supposed to be a straightforward scene became one of the most memorable pieces of unscripted chemistry in cinema history.

source_details.synopsis: The Usual Suspects is a 1995 crime thriller film directed by Bryan Singer and written by Christopher McQuarrie. It stars Kevin Spacey, Gabriel Byrne, Benicio del Toro, Stephen Baldwin, Kevin Pollak, Chazz Palminteri and Pete Postlethwaite. The plot follows the interrogation of Roger "Verbal" Kint, a small-time con man, who is one of only two survivors of a massacre and fire on a ship docked at the Port of Los Angeles. Through flashback and narration, Kint tells an interrogator a convoluted story of events that led him and his criminal companions to the boat, and of a mysterious crime lord—known as Keyser Söze—who controlled them.
